fields.headline: Operations to Resume at 14:30
fields.narration: This is the Incident Commander. I am confirming that operations will resume at 14:30. All personnel must remain on standby. The GCS (GCS-01) is to be powered on, the fleet register (FOM-101) verified on HUOG-NAS01, and the RPIC for Campaign 2026-04 cleared to begin pre-flight checks. No new launches are authorized until the IC confirms the site is safe and all systems are green.
keyFacts: FOM-101 must be verified on HUOG-NAS01
RPIC for Campaign 2026-04 cleared to begin pre-flight checks
No new launches until IC confirmation
fields.expectedAction: All roles confirm readiness. The IC confirms that the GCS (GCS-01) is powered on and the fleet register (FOM-101) is verified. The RPIC for Campaign 2026-04 is cleared to begin pre-flight checks per FOM-101.
fields.facilitatorNote: Confirm that all roles acknowledge the restart order. The GCS-01 status screen should show 'Online' and 'Fleet Register: Verified' when checked.
